%1$s vers la case Remix de la brique %2$: %1$s to the Remix cell of block %2$s…
Chaque brique a déjà un passage dans la: Every block already has a passage in the Remix column: remove one in Live.
Le tempo de la chanson n'est pas connu :: The song's tempo is not known: choose the passage in “Cut up the song”.
Un passage de la chanson dans cette case: A passage of the song in this cell: it starts on the bar and follows the tempo.
« %1$s » est dans la case Remix de la br: “%1$s” is in the Remix cell of block %2$s.
Le son n'a pas pu être rangé sur le télé: The sound couldn't be stored on the phone: it may be out of space.
La page Live : une case par piste et par: The Live page: one cell per track and per block. Touch a cell to launch it at the next start (“Launch on”: the bar, 2 bars…); an empty cell offers to put a sound in it or record yourself. The Remix column plays passages of your separated song.
Dans le Live, REC enregistre tout ce que: In the Live, REC records everything you play (cells, pads, effects, notes). When you stop, your take becomes your song: a new version, or added after it. “Cancel” removes it at once; the old song stays in “Versions”.
Frappe forte : un autre son. Le son du p: Hard hits: another sound. The pad's own sound keeps the soft hits.
Garde le doigt sur un effet : il joue ta: Keep your finger on an effect: it plays as long as you press, then everything comes back. Filter and Roll: slide your finger up to set the sound or the speed of the hits. With “More”: Build-up (a rising whoosh), Drop (the music brakes), Stutter (the sound is chopped).
Enregistre ce que tu joues sur les pads,: Records what you play on the pads, in whole bars, then puts it on a free pad or in a block of the Live. REC, at the top, records your whole performance to make a song of it.
Tout couper arrête tous les pads. Brique: Stop all stops every pad. Blocks opens the full Live (tracks, notes, Acid 303). Effects sets the pads' effects. Big pads shows the pads big, to play together. Share sends your performance.
L'appli joue un petit rythme sur les pad: The app plays a short rhythm on the page's “hit” pads: listen, then play it back. You win up to 3 stars depending on how precise you are.
Coup : le son joue une fois à chaque tou: Hit: the sound plays once at each touch. Loop: one touch starts it in time, another stops it. Hold: it plays as long as your finger stays on the pad.
Les pads d'un même groupe se coupent ent: Pads of the same group cut each other: starting one stops the other. Handy for two drum loops, or an open and a closed hi-hat.
Attaque : le son arrive en douceur au li: Attack: the sound comes in gently instead of hitting at once. End: when the pad stops, the sound fades out gently instead of cutting short.
Le tempo est la vitesse du morceau. Écri: The tempo is the song's speed. Type it, or touch “Tap in time” on each beat. Connected to another machine over MIDI, the app can follow its tempo: MIDI page, “Follow MIDI clock”.
Ce que tu lances part au prochain départ: What you launch starts at the next chosen start (the bar, 2 or 4 bars, a beat, half a bar): everything stays in time. “Cells − +” shows more or fewer blocks in the grid.
Cette case joue un passage de la chanson: This cell plays a passage of the separated song: choose the track (vocals, drums…), the bar where it starts and its length. It starts on the bar and follows the tempo.
Place la tête orange ou écoute, puis : C: Place the orange playhead or listen, then: Cut here cuts at that spot, Start and End shorten the piece, Remove takes it out, Loop makes it loop. Pinch the view to zoom.
Coche les bouts que tu veux, puis envoie: Tick the pieces you want, then send them: onto the pads (one per pad), into the Live, to “Keep” (your library) or onto a track of the song.
Le point le plus haut que le son a le dr: The highest point the sound is allowed to reach. −1 dBTP keeps a margin: the file does not crackle once compressed (M4A, streaming).
Les effets qui finissent le morceau, dan: The effects that finish the song, in order: equalizer, compressor, width, saturation, then the limiter. “Bass in mono” makes the low end solid in a club. Attack and release set how fast the limiter reacts.
A with the master, B without, to compare. “Same loudness” puts them at the same level: you judge the sound, not the volume. A reference is a song you like, played at the same loudness to compare.
LUFS : le volume moyen. LRA : l'écart en: LUFS: the average loudness. LRA: the gap between quiet and loud passages. True peak: the highest point, safe under −1 dBTP. PLR: the gap between the peak and the loudness; when small, the sound is very squashed.
Comment le fichier est fabriqué : fréque: How the file is made: rate and bits (48 kHz, 24 bits is almost always enough), the part exported, the fades and silences at the start and end, and the info (artist, cover).
Avec les envois, chaque piste garde sa r: With the sends, each track keeps its reverb and echo. Without, they are in separate files: you set them yourself in the other software.
D'autres sons pour le même pad, selon la: Other sounds for the same pad, depending on how hard you hit: soft hits keep the pad's sound, hard hits play another. The drums sound more alive.
%1$s LUFS au lieu de %2$s : plus fort, l: %1$s LUFS instead of %2$s: any louder, the sound would get crushed.
Le master s'arrête avant d'écraser les c: The master stops before crushing the hits: the song keeps its punch, a little quieter than the target.
Projets retrouvés dans la sauvegarde du: Projects found in the phone's backup: %d. Their sounds were not in it: choose them again on the pads and tracks.
